source_refs.note: 3. Bioaccumulation and Magnification: a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Bioaccumulation and biomagnification are serious adverse effects of water pollution, where toxic substances like mercury, lead, and pesticides build up in organisms over time. These toxins accumulate in the bodies of aquatic animals and become more concentrated as they move up the food chain. Top predators, including humans, often receive the highest doses.
